name: Brussels Sprouts with Bacon
desc: Sheet pan Brussels sprouts roasted with bacon, onion, bacon grease, and maple syrup.

source.title: Maple Bacon Brussels Sprouts
source.evidence: Amounts for sprouts, bacon, maple syrup, salt and pepper; the site's bacon grease (in place of olive oil) and white onion are kept from the original version.

ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 lb Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved lengthwise
6 strips thick-cut bacon, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 tbsp bacon grease (or extra-virgin olive oil)
1/2 medium white onion, sliced 1/4 inch thick

steps: Place a rack in the upper third of the oven and preheat to 425°F. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil.
Pile the sprouts, bacon pieces, and onion on the sheet. Drizzle with the bacon grease and maple syrup, sprinkle with the salt and pepper, and toss until coated.
Spread in a single layer with the bacon scattered evenly and the sprouts cut side down.
Roast until the sprouts are browned and tender in the center and the bacon is crisp, 20 to 25 minutes, stirring once halfway. Taste and add salt if needed.
tips: Well Plated roasts at 400°F on the center rack for 20 to 30 minutes with olive oil; this version runs hotter on the top shelf for more char. The outer leaves go very dark from the maple syrup, which is expected.
